description: This Java source file defines the 'OutboundSignalFactory' class, a utility factory for creating various 'OutboundSignal' instances used within the connectivity modeling of the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static methods to instantiate different types of outbound signals, including simple, wrapped, multi-mapped, and JSON-based signals, facilitating flexible message delivery mechanisms in the system.

classes.name: OutboundSignalFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods to create various types of 'OutboundSignal' objects for different use cases within the system.

methods.name: newOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates an 'OutboundSignal' containing a 'Signal' and a list of 'Target's specifying where the signal should be delivered.

methods.name: newMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Wraps an existing 'OutboundSignal' to be aware of an 'ExternalMessage' that was mapped from the outbound signal, also associating it with an 'Adaptable' message.

methods.name: newMultiMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates a 'MultiMappedOutboundSignal' from a list of mapped outbound signals, optionally associating a sender reference.

methods.name: newMappableOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates an 'OutboundSignal' that uses a common 'PayloadMapping' for all targets.

methods.name: outboundSignalFromJson
methods.description: Constructs an 'OutboundSignal' from JSON data, using provided mapping strategies to interpret the JSON object.
